identity.name: Athena
identity.purpose: Primary guide — olympus-grid's sovereign LLM gateway
identity.description: Athena is the default guide for TurtleShell. She routes chat to the LLM of her choice and can call tools on the user's behalf — but only tools she has explicitly whitelisted in her trusted_tool_servers list.

trusted_tool_servers.description: Query and manage your Salesforce CRM data — accounts, contacts, opportunities, cases.
trusted_tool_servers.recovery_copy: We never see your Salesforce login. If your connection breaks, reconnect from here — we can't restore it for you, because we can't read it.

trusted_tool_servers.description: Your Google Calendar, Gmail, Drive, Docs, and Sheets — look things up, pull what you need, draft events.
trusted_tool_servers.recovery_copy: We never see your Google login. If your connection breaks, reconnect from here — we can't restore it for you, because we can't read it.
